name: ouro
description: Run deterministic Ouro quality gates from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Assess and remediate quality in the active Codex session.
interface.longDescription: Ouro runs deterministic quality checks and returns immutable run paths, reports, and summaries. Codex owns the quality-check and repair loop, edits, tools, permissions, and commits. Only PASS completes authorized remediation; warnings require further work.
defaultPrompt: Use $ouro-quality to assess this project and report its fresh result.
Use $ouro-quality to fix quality failures and warnings, then rerun until PASS or a concrete blocker.
